messages:
zara: Quick note from today's quant bringup run (v3 -> v3q-slim). Small smoke: 8k requests, mixed chat + longform.
mike: Any visible quality regressions?
zara: Overall pass on safety checks. But two slices show consistent token dropouts in numeric tables (table-extract, invoice-parse). delta EM ~ -1.4%.
trina: Did you enable soft-kv and token-preserve flags? those helped last time.
zara: soft-kv=yes, token-preserve=no (we forgot to flip it; will re-run with preserve on). Current suggestion: hold those two slices from initial 20% rollout and run shadowed preserve-on runs.
ron: For auto-fallback, propose: if any watched slice EM <= -1.0% for 45m (3x15m buckets) -> revert variant for that slice and flag for postmortem.
mike: Add a rate-limited hysteresis: require >1% drop in two consecutive windows OR >1.5% in a single window to trigger. avoids noise.
zara: Agreed. Draft config snippet I pushed to console:
```
rollout:
  baseline: v3
  variant: v3q-slim
  initial: 0.20
  holdback: [table-extract, invoice-parse]
  shadow_holdback: 0.05
  fallback:
    metric: table_numeric_em
    thresholds: [ -0.01@900s, -0.015@300s ]
    required_buckets: 2
```
ops-bot: scheduling rollout staging -> 20% (holdbacks applied). dashboard: https://console.redwood/s/rollouts/1798524680
trina: I'll spin the preserve-on shadow run and post telemetry. If re-run recovers EM by >0.8% we can unhold after 24h.
mike: Please also enable p95 latency alert at 1s. If latency spikes on variant, auto-scale back routes.
zara: Will monitor 2h snapshots and post updates. Ping me if anything trips. :thumbsup:
